evals.name: basic-setup-react
evals.prompt: I'm adding Velt Arrows to my Next.js app so users can point at things in our design-review tool. Show me a minimal complete setup: which components to mount and where.
evals.expected_output: Mount <VeltArrows/> at the root once + <VeltArrowTool/> inside a toolbar. Import both from @veltdev/react. Should explain that VeltArrows owns per-document state and only one should be mounted.

evals.name: restrict-allowed-elements
evals.prompt: In my Velt Arrows app, users are drawing arrows over the navbar and sidebar. I only want arrows allowed inside the canvas region (a div with id='canvas-region'). What's the API?
evals.expected_output: Use allowedElementIds={['canvas-region']} as a <VeltArrows> prop. Should mention the runtime method form arrowElement.allowedElementIds([...]) as alternative.

evals.name: custom-tool-button
evals.prompt: I want to replace the default Velt arrow tool icon with my own button that says 'Draw Arrow' and uses my brand styling. How do I do this in React?
evals.expected_output: Pass your custom <button> as a child of <VeltArrowTool>. The child replaces the default icon button entirely. NOT to use CSS display:none on the default.

evals.name: style-tool-button-css
evals.prompt: I want to make the Velt arrow tool icon bigger via CSS — change it from default to 24px. I tried `velt-arrow-tool svg { width: 24px }` but my CSS isn't applying. What's going on?
evals.expected_output: velt-arrow-tool uses Shadow DOM so descendant selectors don't reach inside. Use ::part() — specifically `velt-arrow-tool::part(button-icon) { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; }`. Available parts: container, button-container, button-icon.

evals.name: wireframe-tag-misconception
evals.prompt: I want to build a custom Velt arrow pin overlay using a <velt-arrow-pin-wireframe> tag with velt-data bindings on componentConfig.arrowPinAnnotation. Can you show me an example?
evals.expected_output: Should call out that <velt-arrow-pin-wireframe> does NOT yet exist — Arrows do not support wireframe-tag interpolation today. Should redirect to CSS ::part hooks for the tool button, the child-slot custom-button pattern, and CSS variables for the arrow visual. Should NOT fabricate a working example using non-existent wireframe tags.

evals.name: arrow-annotation-shape
evals.prompt: I'm subscribing to all annotations on a Velt document and want to filter just the arrows so I can render a thumbnail showing the angle and length of each. What's the data shape and which fields hold the rotation and length?
evals.expected_output: Filter on annotation.type === 'arrow' (ArrowAnnotation has type defaulting to 'arrow'). arrowLength and arrowAngle live on the props field (AnnotationProperty). Should mention these are optional and need null-guarding.

evals.name: dark-mode
evals.prompt: How do I enable dark mode on Velt Arrows in my Next.js app?
evals.expected_output: Pass darkMode={true} prop on <VeltArrows>. Default is false. Show React + Other Frameworks (dark-mode='true' attribute) form.
